subject.title: fix(models): respect models.mode=replace in 'openclaw models list' output

question: Should this PR be adopted as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94705, or should maintainers choose one of the sibling candidate PRs instead?
rationale: The patch is small and aligns with the documented contract, but multiple open PRs target the same compatibility-sensitive config behavior with different coverage and scope choices.

options.title: Adopt this minimal fix with coverage
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix after rebasing and confirming focused regression coverage for default, `--all`, and provider-filter replace-mode behavior.

options.title: Choose a sibling candidate
options.body: Prefer another open candidate if its tests or wildcard/provider semantics better match the maintainer-approved behavior, then close the other same-root PRs after that path lands.

options.title: Pause for behavior clarification
options.body: Hold all same-root PRs until maintainers explicitly define replace-mode default versus browse visibility semantics.
